Maria — perfect, thanks for the owners. Updated plan below and explicit action items for this week's checkpoint (Thursday 24th EOD):

Action items (owner — due):
- Add acceptance criteria to SOW and prepare DocuSign form (Ben Carter — 2027-06-28)

Cutover highlights (for runbook):
- Pre-cutover: feature-flagged canary traffic, KV cache warm-up, full tokenization smoke tests.
- Cutover: stop ingestion, apply model swap, validate end-to-end inference on 10K requests, promote traffic.
- Post-cutover: monitoring window 2h (intense) then 24h light watch.
- Fallback: feature toggle rollback OR DB snapshot restore (ordered preference: toggle first, DB restore only if rollback doesn't address data drift).

I've attached runbook v3 with inline comments—please review. We'll take the items above in the Thursday checkpoint and publish a consolidated go/no-go decision card after the rehearsal.
